Own a kosher catering business? A dental office? A community practice?

Your neighbors walk into shul every day. At every minyan, they look at the screen for the zmanim.

DigitalShul screens carry a small footer with ads from local Jewish businesses only. Your ad sits next to the times your community checks most.

And your ad does more than sell. It is what keeps the screen free for the shul.

See how advertising works:
https://digitalshul.com/targeted-ads.html

#DigitalShul #JewishCommunity #SouthFlorida

Every shul has someone who used to reprint the zmanim sheet.

At Young Israel Chabad of Pembroke Pines, that job is gone. The DigitalShul screen on the wall shows the zmanim, minyan times and Shabbat times. All of it calculated from the shul's own coordinates.

The result: precision minyanim and clearer communication, without adding tasks for staff. The Rav and the kehillah focus on what matters.

Read the full story on our Resources page:
https://digitalshul.com/resources.html
